steps.title: Parse build logs
steps.description: Analyze the ASTRETHOST build failure log to isolate the exact XML parsing exception in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Inspect activity_main.xml structure
steps.description: Check for unclosed tags, malformed element names, and quote formatting issues around line 117.

steps.title: Fix TextView tags syntax
steps.description: Rewrite the target TextView tag with valid attribute declarations and standard XML self-closing tags.

steps.title: Clean activity layout constraints
steps.description: Verify general linear layout nesting and scrolling view properties are properly formed and aligned.

steps.title: Inspect strings.xml values
steps.description: Confirm the string resources inside strings.xml do not introduce unescaped quotes or invalid string literals.

steps.title: Review floating mic view components
steps.description: Verify floating_mic_layout.xml attributes to prevent resource compiler conflicts.

steps.title: Verify service XML schema
steps.description: Validate accessibility_service_config.xml features and permission attributes.

steps.title: Validate Manifest registration
steps.description: Confirm correct class paths for MainActivity and VoiceAccessibilityService with proper namespace mappings.

steps.title: Perform static code validation
steps.description: Verify imports and components reference valid resources before assembly runs.

steps.title: Building Voice Control Assistant
steps.description: Trigger the Gradle environment assembly process to build the corrected package successfully.
